acceptance_tests.title: Mission pack files exist and are valid
criteria: FOUNDER_PACKET.md, CURRENT_STATE_AUDIT.md, BLUEPRINT.json, ACCEPTANCE_TESTS.json, and TASK_LIST.md exist
BLUEPRINT.json parses and references valid target files where they already exist
Pre-commit checks pass

acceptance_tests.title: Drift repair executor fixes known patterns
criteria: scripts/build-queue-drift-repair.mjs runs with --dry-run and lists actionable repairs for the 11 pending steps
With --apply, it repairs missing file_contains, export aliases, route aliases, and auto-register entries deterministically
npm run builder:preflight passes after repairs

acceptance_tests.title: Drift repair executor refuses unsafe repairs
criteria: Executor refuses to modify auth/money/data modules without explicit safe-class flag
Executor refuses repairs not derivable from BUILD_QUEUE contract
Repairs that touch protected files are logged as BLOCKED, not silently applied

acceptance_tests.title: Never-stop factory calls repair executor
criteria: services/never-stop-product-factory.js attempts deterministic repair before marking a step BLOCKED
Artifact proof is re-evaluated after repair
A repaired step can be claimed in the next bp-priority:once run

acceptance_tests.title: Lessons log is written and consumed
criteria: data/build-queue-drift-lessons.jsonl has at least one entry per repair attempt
scripts/build-queue-lessons-report.mjs can aggregate by failure family
services/builderos-improvement-loop.js reads recurring failure families and proposes improvements

acceptance_tests.title: Overnight daemon keeps the queue moving
criteria: scripts/builderos-overnight-daemon.mjs runs for 1 hour without human input
It invokes self-heal, drift repair, and bp-priority:once
It stops cleanly when no actionable work exists
Logs show progress or a clear halt reason

acceptance_tests.title: Runtime constitutional protocols are wired
criteria: services/knowledge-judgment-split.js, services/goal-decomposition.js, services/cognitive-spine-health.js, services/asset-evolution-governance.js, services/reality-hierarchy-reconciler.js, and services/founder-cognitive-load-optimizer.js export functions and have tests
chair-lumin-unified.js consumes them
npm run builder:preflight passes

acceptance_tests.title: Remaining BUILD_QUEUE backlog is cleared or parked with reason
criteria: Pending queue is 0 or every pending step has a documented blocker_class and park_until
No false-done drift remains
Product homes updated with Change Receipts

acceptance_tests.title: Competitive benchmark harness and IDE bridge exist
criteria: scripts/benchmark-vs-baseline.mjs runs and emits a receipt JSON
scripts/ide-bridge.mjs exposes builder commands over HTTP or WebSocket
docs/reports/BUILDEROS_COMPETITIVE_BENCHMARK.md is created
